steps.text: Go down the sewer grate north of the Rookgaard temple.
steps.source: Go into the Rookgaard sewer (Mapper Coords 125.94, 125.204, 7).

steps.text: Make your way west past the rats and go down the ladder.
steps.source: After entering, make your way west, and go down a Ladder, you will encounter a few rats on your way

steps.text: Run past the rats to the box in the north-east of the room: the rapier.
steps.source: Once you go down, you will encounter 3-7 rats, which you can kill or simply run past through. The quest-box is in the north-east part of the room, use it to obtain a Rapier.
